note: Parent 6206fb1d (submission 1bffc5bb, the first-fold carry-word, lazy congruent finish add and aliased-pack package on PR1013/PR1050 plus the isolated negative-Y seeded multiply-add). New executable content, all of it inside the seeded multiply-add and the deferred-ordinate point addition of the rolled fixed-base chain: the four seed limbs are consumed straight from the asm input operands instead of a staged .u64 scratch; the second fold packs z8 directly instead of through an alias; the abscissa accumulator of the point addition is the caller's own abscissa slot, whose last read precedes every write of that accumulator; and the deferred instantiation names the ordinate slot as the destination of the closing R*(V-X3) product. Each item has its own kill switch and restores byte for byte at 0.
